# Moonleaf

> Moonleaf is a free Android app (Android 7.0+) that saves web novels from Royal Road and RoliaScan as EPUB files on the phone and reads them, or any EPUB the user already has, in a built-in reader inspired by KOReader. No account, no ads, no analytics; the library stays on the device. Distributed as an APK from GitHub, not Google Play.

## Key facts

- Price: free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.
- Platform: Android 7.0 or later. APK download of about 160 MB. iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux builds are possible from source but not published.
- Supported sources: Royal Road and RoliaScan text novels (not image-only manga). Any EPUB file can also be imported.
- What it does: add a novel by URL, create an EPUB on the device, read it in the app with "Read now" or "Continue reading", or export the EPUB file. "Update EPUB" collects new chapters and keeps reading position.
- Reader features: paged or continuous view; font (including custom TTF/OTF), size, weight, line/word/letter spacing, indent, paragraph spacing, margins, justification; page colors Paper, Sepia, Sage, Dusk, Night, E-ink and E-ink dark; configurable tap zones, swipe, pinch-to-zoom text and keyboard page turns; configurable status bar; contents with page numbers; bookmarks; highlights with notes in several colors; full-text search; go to page or percent; footnote previews; dictionary, Wikipedia and translation look-ups in the browser; reading statistics and time-left estimates.
- Library: Mihon-inspired cover grid or list, Plan to read / Reading / Completed shelves, search, history and progress bars.
- Privacy: all data (library, EPUBs, positions, highlights, statistics) is stored on the device. The app connects only to the novel sites the user chooses.
- Affiliation: independent project, not affiliated with KOReader, Mihon, Royal Road or RoliaScan, and contains no code from KOReader or Mihon.
